content: अशून्य {%a.%} .²1 Not empty or vacant; तस्य निन्यतुरशून्यतामुभे <ls>R. 19. 13</ls>; occupied. .²2 Not unattended to, fulfilled, executed; स्वनियोगमशून्यं कुरु (occurring frequently in dramas), execute or go about your business. .{@-न्यम्@} .²1 Not a void. .²2 Something sent to accompany another; लेखस्याशून्यार्थं किंचिदनुप्रेषितम् <ls>Mu. 5</ls>; अयं लेखशून्यार्थो भविष्यति {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%} (an accompaniment such as a customary present accompanying a letter).
